text:
Here are some of my small successes after 4 months of training here: I went from 52kg to 49kg, my waist circumference increased by 2cm, my back and shoulders are more defined, not only has my fitness improved, but I've also formed a habit of regular exercise, I feel more relaxed, look more beautiful, and feel more confident.

I've trained with two personal trainers, Tony and Thai, both of whom have been very supportive. My initial goal was to be able to train on my own after 3 months with a PT, and indeed, after 3 months I could train on my own. But because of Thai's dedication and expertise, I've continued with him for 4 months now. He's very dedicated and not at all careless; his personalized training plan is tailored to my individual goals, he carefully observes and corrects my form during each session, and explains all my questions thoroughly, not just going through the motions. Plus, he makes great videos – I have tons of great photos for social media after my workouts! ^^
The training space is comfortable, not too crowded, and I don't have to worry about being overcharged like with chain stores.

I've also had some small successes after 4 months of training here. Overall, it's great. If there were more machines for women, I'd definitely stay here forever!

author: duyhai hong
text:
The Shine Fitness and Yoga is truly a high-quality gym and deserves every star in this review! Since I started training here, I've felt a noticeable positive change not only in my physical health but also in my mental well-being.
Modern and top-notch facilities: The gym is fully equipped with a variety of modern machines, from weight training areas, treadmills, and stationary bikes to specialized equipment for each muscle group. Everything is kept clean and organized scientifically, creating a comfortable and inspiring training space. In particular, the yoga room is very spacious and airy, providing a feeling of absolute relaxation.
Professional and dedicated trainers: This is the brightest point of The Shine. The personal trainers (PTs) here not only have extensive professional knowledge but are also extremely enthusiastic, dedicated, and always listen to the needs of their members. They are always ready to guide, correct movements, and offer helpful advice to achieve personal goals. The professionalism and friendliness of the team have greatly motivated me throughout my training. A big thank you to Vinh (Jackson) for his dedicated guidance.

Energetic training environment: The atmosphere at The Shine is always full of positive energy. From the friendly and welcoming reception staff to the fellow trainees, everything creates a civilized and comfortable environment. I always feel welcome and motivated to come to the gym every day.

Outstanding amenities: In addition to the main training area, The Shine also has clean changing rooms, secure lockers, and convenient showers. These are small details, but they demonstrate professionalism and care for the customer experience.

In short, The Shine Fitness and Yoga is not just an ordinary gym, but a holistic wellness center where you can find motivation, joy, and achieve your physical and mental goals. I will definitely continue to support The Shine and confidently recommend it to anyone seeking a high-quality training facility. Come and experience it for yourself; you won't be disappointed!

author: Hoàng Vũ Lê
text: The gym is beautiful, the service is great, and the personal trainers are enthusiastic. The female staff are very friendly. In short, it's fantastic.

author: Linh Lê
text: The gym is comfortable, and the receptionists are very nice. The personal trainers are also cute, I highly recommend it! The prices are reasonable, not expensive at all. Honestly, I'm so happy to have found a gym I really like!

author: Nhân Đỗ
text: The gym has enough machines, and while the service isn't top-notch, I got a 12-month package through a transfer and have been working out for two months now, which is great. I didn't sign up for a personal trainer, but the guys there were very helpful. I'd give it a 10/10 if anyone else complained! ♥️♥️ The receptionist, Ms. Tram, was also very enthusiastic and friendly! 🌹🌹
